# capi_remediate_machine (Action)

Mark a Machine for remediation (the `cluster.x-k8s.io/remediate-machine` annotation): the MachineHealthCheck that covers it treats it as unhealthy and its owner replaces it, subject to the check's remediation limits.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Have the MachineHealthCheck replace one machine now.
action "capi_remediate_machine" "worker" {
  config {
    machine   = "prod-workers-7c9f4-xk2pq"
    namespace = "capi"
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `machine` (String) Machine name.

### Optional

- `namespace` (String) Namespace. Default `default`.
